editorial:
Imagine being on a hit dating show, almost at the finish line, only to find out your hometown date is with the one person you tried to forget. That is exactly what happens to Ally. She is fighting for love on screen, but when she heads home, she runs right into her high school sweetheart. The whole movie feels like a warm hug, filled with snowy scenery and that nervous energy you get when you see an old flame. It is a sweet, cozy story that plays with the idea of whether your first love is actually your true love.

You will love how the chemistry between the leads feels natural and not forced. While the plot is pretty predictable, it moves along quickly and keeps you smiling. The only downside is that some of the side characters are a bit cliché, but it does not ruin the fun.
endingExplained: In the end, Ally realizes that the guy from the dating show is not the right match for her. She chooses to follow her heart instead of the cameras. She and her high school sweetheart clear up their old misunderstandings and decide to give their relationship another real shot. The movie wraps up with them happily together in their snowy town, proving that some loves are worth waiting for.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Hallmark style romances and second chance love stories.
